title: Zscaler and SUSE Enterprise Linux Podman Deployment Guide

blocks.text: The Zscaler and SUSE Enterprise Linux Podman Deployment Guide provides instructions on integrating Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Private Access (ZPA) to work with SUSE Enterprise Linux.

Podman is the default container management and orchestration tool on SUSE Linux Enterprise. In addition to providing a drop-in replacement for Docker Open Source Engine, Podman offers several advantages, including the ability to run containers in rootless mode. This allows regular users to deploy containers without elevated privileges.
This deployment guide explains how to deploy Zscaler App Connectors on SUSE Enterprise Linux using Podman.
